title: Top-conference paper visual research
scope: Representative official Best Paper, Outstanding Paper, honorable mention, and runner-up figures from CVPR, ICML, NeurIPS, and ICLR.
evidence_boundary: Figure descriptions are source observations; reusable rules and tokens are derived design guidance. No external figure image or experimental value is vendored.

entries.paper_title: VGGT: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
entries.typography: short labels; color-coded correspondence lines
entries.evidence_encoding: real multi-view images → point-cloud/camera representation → depth/track outputs
reusable_rules: anchor the overview in real input images

entries.paper_title: Navigation World Models
entries.typography: minimal labels; action/time annotations on the frame rail
entries.evidence_encoding: history frames + action/time → conditional diffusion transformer → future frames, goal, score
reusable_rules: align frames and actions by time

entries.paper_title: Generative Image Dynamics
entries.typography: compact scientific labels with frequency/time units
entries.evidence_encoding: real image → spectral/motion representation → looping or interactive video; power spectrum and sliding-window metrics
reusable_rules: reuse method colors in line charts

entries.paper_title: Mip-Splatting: Alias-free 3D Gaussian Splatting
entries.typography: short method labels; paired zoom crops
entries.evidence_encoding: frequency/filter schematic paired with aligned qualitative crops
reusable_rules: highlight one contribution without recoloring all baselines

entries.paper_title: AlphaEdit: Null-Space Constrained Model Editing for Language Models
entries.typography: direct metric labels; compact method legend
entries.evidence_encoding: per-metric annular bars with method color and radial scale

entries.paper_title: Learning Dynamics of LLM Finetuning
entries.typography: shared axes; short panel titles
entries.evidence_encoding: training trajectories and an accumulated-influence heatmap
reusable_rules: keep baseline and extension colors stable

entries.paper_title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
entries.typography: few stage labels; memory and propagation explicit
entries.evidence_encoding: prompt/frame → memory encoder → mask decoder → propagated video mask
reusable_rules: separate prompt, memory, and prediction roles

entries.paper_title: Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction
entries.typography: stage labels, log axes, fit equation in-panel
entries.evidence_encoding: raster tokenization vs coarse-to-fine scale grids; quality–cost bubble and scaling laws
reusable_rules: use log axes for order-of-magnitude ranges

entries.paper_title: Guiding a Diffusion Model with a Bad Version of Itself
entries.typography: paired labels; minimal arrows
entries.evidence_encoding: good/bad model trajectories and guidance direction
reusable_rules: show paired trajectories side by side
use one accent for the guidance signal

entries.paper_title: Not All Tokens Are What You Need for Pretraining
entries.typography: shared axes and concise ablation labels
entries.evidence_encoding: token subset/control ablations across small multiples
reusable_rules: group the ablation variable in one visual band

entries.paper_title: PRISM Alignment Dataset
entries.typography: compact facet labels; neutral data cards
entries.evidence_encoding: dataset source/composition/quality facets
reusable_rules: use small multiples instead of dense prose

entries.paper_title: A Watermark for Large Language Models
entries.typography: token-level highlighting plus z-score/ROC axes
entries.evidence_encoding: text example directly paired with statistical evidence and ROC curves
reusable_rules: use markers and color for parameter sweeps

entries.paper_title: Learning-Rate-Free Learning by D-Adaptation
entries.typography: log-scale axes and short method legend
entries.evidence_encoding: optimization curves, scaling/robustness comparisons, and ablations

entries.paper_title: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators (UniSim)
entries.typography: short action labels and aligned frame strip
entries.evidence_encoding: multi-source hub plus timestamped simulator rollout
reusable_rules: use hub-and-spoke only for shared multimodal systems
show autoregressive handoff with dashed links

entries.paper_title: Vision Transformers Need Registers
entries.typography: two-level column headers and one shared colorbar
entries.evidence_encoding: Input × model × condition matrix with shared heatmap scale
reusable_rules: make the intervention the only changed condition

entries.paper_title: Efficiently Reconstructing Dynamic Scenes One D4RT at a Time
entries.typography: one central latent label; repeated blocks compressed as ×N/×M
entries.evidence_encoding: video → fixed global scene representation → independent spatio-temporal queries → depth/points/tracks/camera
reusable_rules: use query arrows instead of repeated output cards
show one encoder and one decoder with ×N/×M

entries.paper_title: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation
entries.typography: sparse-voxel labels; short topology/appearance tags
entries.evidence_encoding: native 3D input → structured sparse O-Voxel latent → geometry/appearance generation
reusable_rules: use a sparse grid as the visual metaphor
avoid turning every voxel into a card

entries.paper_title: NitroGen: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Gaming Agents
entries.typography: semantic band labels; minimal box chrome
entries.evidence_encoding: game observations + large video/action corpus ↔ vision-action foundation model → gamepad actions
reusable_rules: use data/environment → model → control as a semantic band
tie real gameplay frames to the model

entries.paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models
entries.typography: stable attention schematic with one red/amber gate marker
entries.evidence_encoding: attention block variants beside perplexity/training evidence
reusable_rules: place mechanism and measured curve side by side

entries.paper_title: Artificial Hivemind
entries.typography: direct facet labels; one compact legend
entries.evidence_encoding: prompt/participant taxonomy paired with model-output similarity and homogeneity plots
reusable_rules: make facets carry the experimental condition

entries.paper_title: Superposition Yields Robust Neural Scaling
entries.typography: concept labels beside log/log scaling panels; slope annotation in-panel
entries.evidence_encoding: conceptual hidden-space geometry paired with loss-vs-dimension curves and external LLM points
reusable_rules: pair a mechanism illustration with measured curves
reuse the same palette in both halves
label fit slope and external evidence

entries.paper_title: Scaling Laws for Pre-training Agents and World Models
entries.typography: log-log axes, facet labels for tokenizer/task/architecture
entries.evidence_encoding: loss vs model/data/compute power laws with fit lines, exponents, and uncertainty

entries.paper_title: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Scaling Law Estimation
entries.typography: trajectory lines with final fit summary and uncertainty annotation
entries.evidence_encoding: many model/checkpoint trajectories, fitted laws, and seed variability
reusable_rules: do not collapse checkpoint trajectories to one endpoint

entries.paper_title: MET3R: Measuring Multi-View Consistency in Generated Images
entries.typography: fixed frame rows; metric directions in headers
entries.evidence_encoding: fixed conditioning view → multi-frame qualitative rows → consistency/quality bubble and temporal curves
reusable_rules: fix conditioning, crop, and sequence length
pair frame grids with metric panels
use black dashed real-video lower bound

entries.paper_title: See3D: You See it, You Got it
entries.typography: clock/gauge/mask/flame icon semantics; shared method order
entries.evidence_encoding: video curation → time-dependent visual condition → conditional MVD model → aligned qualitative grid and metrics
reusable_rules: make data provenance numeric and visible
use dedicated icons for trainable/control semantics
keep qualitative order identical to the metric table

entries.paper_title: Mixture-of-Scores: Robust Image-Text Data Valuation via Three Lines of Code
entries.typography: histogram/radar cascade plus categorical benchmark bubble plot
entries.evidence_encoding: score variation → filtered subset/rank disparity → downstream quality; bubble area = scoring model size
reusable_rules: show causal propagation with dashed grouping boxes
keep bubble size continuous and separate from color

entries.paper_title: AA-CLIP: Enhancing Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection via Anomaly-Aware CLIP
entries.typography: shared y-limits; parameter value on each x-axis; one global legend
entries.evidence_encoding: 2×4 Image/Pixel AUROC panels over λ, γ, K_T, and K_I
reusable_rules: avoid repeating legends in every cell

entries.paper_title: Diffusion Actor-Critic with Entropy Regulator
entries.typography: shared x/y scale; translucent variability bands
entries.evidence_encoding: training return vs. iterations for entropy, noise, and diffusion-step ablations
reusable_rules: use a shared axis across ablation panels

entries.paper_title: An Exactly Solvable Model for Emergence and Scaling Laws in the Multitask Sparse Parity Problem
entries.typography: shared log-log axes; formula and exponent in panel corner
entries.evidence_encoding: solid simulation curves vs dotted theoretical power laws across time/data/parameter/compute scales
reusable_rules: reuse a single legend across panels
annotate equations instead of adding another legend

entries.paper_title: Ctrl-X: Controlling Structure and Appearance in Image Generation
entries.typography: reference inputs separated from output grid; τ ticks at the edges
entries.evidence_encoding: structure/appearance inputs → method grid with adjacent DINO metrics and τ_s×τ_a sweep
reusable_rules: keep inputs outside the output grid
let row/column edges carry parameter semantics
put metric directions in the caption/table

entries.paper_title: Scaling Laws for Optimal Data Mixtures
entries.typography: model-size markers; observed/predicted line-style distinction; extrapolation callout
entries.evidence_encoding: loss vs FLOPs with mixture colors and scaling-law prediction; optimal mixture/extrapolation ribbon
reusable_rules: model size = marker, domain mixture = color

entries.paper_title: Data Mixing Can Induce Phase Transitions in Knowledge Acquisition
entries.typography: log x-axis with explicit critical-threshold guides
entries.evidence_encoding: accuracy curves with sharp transitions vs model size or mixing ratio
reusable_rules: do not force a smooth scaling fit
make critical values the annotation focus

entries.paper_title: Algorithmic Progress in Language Models
entries.typography: density + median marker; ordered swarm; compact specification matrix
entries.evidence_encoding: doubling-time density, model-spec robustness swarm, and pre/post cutoff comparison with explicit 90% CI
reusable_rules: sort the swarm by held-out fit
